01 / CUTTLEFISH

A quick change of mind.

Hold a station, investigate a visitor, flash a changing pattern, then gather and retreat through ink. The original scene tools remain a click away.

02 / MANTA

Make room for a wingbeat.

A guide takes the long arc. Companions share a current, banking through depth and gliding past their neighbors without borrowing a cuttlefish’s ink.

03 / OCTOPUS

Let the arms lead.

Search a reef edge, inspect a point of interest, then gather into a cup when startled. Eight bounded arm chains share one intention.
